head.title: Acumen Career Academy
head.script: // GitHub Pages SPA routing fix // Redirects all 404s back to index.html with the path encoded as a query param var l = window.location; l.replace( l.protocol + "//" + l.hostname + (l.port ? ":" + l.port : "") + l.pathname .split("/") .slice(0, 1) .join("/") + "/?p=/" + l.pathname .slice(1) .replace(/&/g, "~and~") + (l.search ? "&q=" + l.search.slice(1).replace(/&/g, "~and~") : "") + l.hash );
